title: Taco-Flavor Ground Beef
ingredients: ½ teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
1 teaspoon ground cumin, plus more to taste
¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 pound of ground beef and break it up with a spatula.

Stir in ½ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon black pepper, 1 teaspoon cumin, ¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes, and 2 minced garlic cloves. Cook, stirring and breaking up the beef, until it reaches 160°F on a food thermometer.
Taste the cooked beef. Add more seasoning as needed, starting with cumin and salt.
